info.title: /IOTCONNECT™ Master API
info.description:
Master REST API contains information of Dashboard, FAQ, Property (Custom Fields) Methods and other lockups data.

Headers

Needed Headers for all the API.

Authorization     Bearer + access_token (Generated From api/v1.1/auth/login API)
Content-Type    application/json

get.description:
This API endpoint provides you the list of available FAQs.

You can also add the filters as given in the parameters. Though the filters are optional, to apply them, you need to send these filter parameters in a query string.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort by name and order/ex:name asc

401.description: Indicates that authentication is failed because of the token is invalid or expired or missing.

403.description: Indicates that the user is not authorized to access this section.

412.description: Indicates that a condition set for this request is failed, and the request cannot be carried out.

500.description: Indicates that the request could not be carried out because of some technical error on the server.

200.description: Indicates that FAQ list is loaded successfully.

204.description: Indicates that the request has been successfully processed and no records found.

409.description:
Indicates that the request could not be carried out because of one of the below or other conflicts on the server
Company doesn't exist, Logged in user is invalid etc.

get.description:
Property APIs allow you to create and manage custom properties. Custom properties have property types. Examples of property types are device, user, entity.

This API endpoint provides you the list of property types. You need these property types at the time of creating a property.
